It is not hard to find an ADJUNCT teaching position in English - it is challenging to find a full-time teaching English teaching position in university. 18 grad credits would make it possible for her to teach part-time on-line all across the country, not just where she lives.  So, yes, it is worth getting the additional grad hours to teach both Dual Credit in her high school and also as a side job.  I taught full-time Advanced Placement history and French courses in high school and part-time college courses in the evenings and online for over 30 years. The colleges where I taught were constantly looking for part-time English instructors. Loads of jobs for part-timers. The other area she can consider is getting grad hours in speech communications to teach speech at a local community college.  Many of the degrees have a speech requirement and it certainly is a far less time consuming job than teaching English! At one of the colleges where I taught students could even take speech online - they had to get together 12 friends and give a speech, tape it, and put it on their YT channel. You can also look at related jobs like editing technical manuals, corporate training in the summers, etc.
